title: Long-read DNA preparation for bacterial isolates
author: He Sun
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.64ghgtw
materials: Stay on the magnet and remove supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate cation-adjusted Müller-Hinton broth (CAMHB) with a bacterial colony and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 mL of CAMHB to a 15 ml Falcon tube.
Add 1/4 of a 10 µl-loop of colony from an agar plate into the solution.
Vortex the mixture for 5 s at maximum speed.
Incubate the mixture overnight on a shaking bench at 120 rpm at 37 °C.

steps.title: Harvest and Resuspend Bacteria
steps.instruction: Collect the bacterial cells and resuspend them in Buffer G3.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 2 ml of the incubated mixture into a 2.5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge the mixture at 20 °C for 10 minutes.
Resuspend the bacterial pellet in 1 mL of Buffer G3 by vortexing.

steps.title: Lysis and Digestion
steps.instruction: Perform enzymatic lysis of the bacterial cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL of Proteinase K and 25 µL of lysozyme (100 mg/ml).
Gently resuspend the mixture and incubate at 37 °C for 20 min without shaking.
Add 400 µL of Buffer G4.
Gently resuspend the mixture and incubate at 50 °C for 30 min without shaking.

steps.title: Sample Preparation for Column
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysed sample for column loading.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 20 °C for 5 minutes.
Add 1 mL of Buffer N2 (room temperature) to the sample.
Vortex the mixture for 15 s at maximum speed.

steps.title: DNA Purification via Column
steps.instruction: Purify genomic DNA using an AXG 20 column.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate the AXG 20 column with 1 mL of Buffer N2.
Load 1 ml of the mixture on the column and allow it to enter the resin by gravity flow.
Discard the supernatant.
Reload 1 ml of the mixture on the column (do not reload if the previous mixture has not filtered completely to avoid clogging).
Transfer the supernatant to a 5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Wash the column three times with 1 mL of Buffer N3.
Elute the genomic DNA with 1 mL of Buffer N5 and collect in a 2.5 ml Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: DNA Cleanup and Concentration
steps.instruction: Clean and concentrate the DNA using AMPure magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 µL of AMPure magnetic beads (0.35 volume) to 1000 µL of the DNA sample and resuspend gently by hand.
Incubate the mixture for 10 minutes at 20 °C (room temperature).
Spin down and let the beads bind to a magnetic plate until the liquid is clear.
Wash with 150 µL of 80% Ethanol, ensuring the pellet is not disturbed.
Remove the supernatant.
Spin down and bind beads to the magnetic plate again; remove residual liquid with a 10 µl pipette.
Add 55 µL of nuclease free water and resuspend gently.

steps.title: Final Recovery and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Recover the DNA and verify its concentration and length.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the DNA solution at 37 °C for 15 minutes.
Spin down and place on the magnetic plate.
Retrieve the supernatant (DNA) with a 10 µl pipette.
Determine dsDNA concentration (e.g., by Qubit) and DNA length (via Agarose gel or Bioanalyzer).
